caseNameFull: Cornelia G. Goodrich v. West Lumber Company
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Hannis Taylor for plaintiffs in error., Mr. H. M. Garwood for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the ground that there is no federal question presented in the record. Gasquet v. Lapeyre, 242 U. S. 367, 369-370.
